name: voice quota dies — cloud gives up, Piper carries the film
_why: 2026-08-12: seven proof runs emptied the TTS quota and a fourteen-shot film died with every frame already paid for. Narration gets four attempts on a 502, then the worker switches to in-house Piper AND STAYS switched.

job.prompt: a brave mouse in a bakery

plan.title: The Mouse Under the Bakery
plan.setting: a warm old bakery at night, flour dust in the lamplight

shots.still: A small brown mouse peers out from under a wooden floorboard.
shots.narration: Under the floorboards of an old bakery there lived a very small and very brave mouse.

shots.still: Wide view of the dark bakery, moonlight on the counters.
shots.narration: Every night when the baker went home, the mouse came out to see what the world had left behind.

shots.still: The mouse carries a crumb twice its size across the floor.
shots.narration: And every night she carried home one crumb, which to a mouse is a very great treasure indeed.

_slow: The four retries wait 30/60/90s for real — expect ~3 minutes.

_expect._note: THE ASSERTION THAT MATTERS IS THE ABSENT ONE. This scenario scripts a fifth voice answer that SUCCEEDS. If the worker ever asks for it, the Piper switch did not hold and shots 2 and 3 drifted back to the metered cloud — the 2026-08-12 incident, silently back.
